label: More such package and mode of possession: degree-indexed induction controls, checked
meaning: One finite interpretation with the respect fixed by degree. It shows that the formal possession gap needs a degree-indexed respect (or the threshold quality 'being hot'), that the ordinary-comparative gap and the failure of the MORE_3 reading of 'more such' need only the respect of having some heat, that a stipulated MORE_4 reading of 'more such' holds in the same case, and that the formal reading of 'nothing moves except as in act' fails where its inclusive reading holds. A structural surrogate; it is not evidence that a premise is false of reality.
